retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast theatrical composition featuring a central figure in a circular spotlight with a sharp, offset shadow against a black background.
excludeWhen: soft pastel color palettes are requested
busy or textured backgrounds are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A central female figure in black leather attire stands within a large, bright circular spotlight. The lighting creates a hard-edged, slightly offset shadow against the back of the spotlight circle, while the surrounding frame is deep black. Typography is placed at the extreme top and bottom edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a circular light field
Hard-edged shadow mimicking the subject's pose
Extreme contrast between the white spotlight and black negative space
Symmetrical typographic placement at the top corners
coreInvariants: Circular spotlight as the primary framing device
Deep black void surrounding the central light
Sharp, distinct shadow cast directly behind the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subject centered vertically and horizontally within the spotlight circle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white circular spotlight against the black background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright center, move to the subject's face, follow the outstretched arms to the top corners, and drop to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black negative space framing the central circle.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with low saturation, focusing on monochromatic tones with a single warm accent.

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a Didone-style serif with extreme stroke contrast
Bottom text uses a wide, geometric sans-serif with heavy tracking

composition.position: Top left and top right corners

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in black negative space below the spotlight

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for elegance at the top, wide sans-serif for modern impact at the bottom.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast vertical strokes of the top display text.
Matches the geometric, wide-set nature of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body studio portrait of a person in black leather clothing, centered inside a large, bright white circular spotlight. The background outside the circle must be pure black. A sharp, dark shadow of the person should be cast onto the white circle, slightly offset to the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white high-contrast serif text in the top left and top right corners. Add red wide-spaced geometric sans-serif text centered at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the spotlight a perfect circle?
Is the background outside the circle pure black?
Is the bottom text red and extremely tracked?
Is there a sharp shadow cast within the spotlight?

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black negative space
Verify the shadow matches the subject's pose
Ensure typography is aligned to the edges
Confirm the spotlight is a clean geometric circle
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in [Attire] + [Circular Spotlight] + [Offset Shadow] + [Corner Serif Text] + [Bottom Wide Sans Text]
